summary: All 11 targets promoted to exact full records; nothing left zone-level. The shokugekinosoma.fandom episode-side chapter fields and chapter-side 'ep' reverse fields (walked via the MediaWiki API for chs 4-60, 102, 148-156, 192-205, 209-217) agree perfectly with each other and with every stored bracket anchor (ep45 143-148, ep49 164-166+149-151, ep55 188-192, ep57 201-205, ep59 206-209, ep61 211-214+217, ep24 58-60, eps 17-18 35-39). MAL episode threads gave page-exact confirmations for the prelims (ep 19 ends about a third into ch 46; ep 20 ends at the end of ch 48; ep 22 adapted exactly 5 chapters, Block B only) and confirmed the ep 46 skip of the end-of-149 Azami reveal and the ep 56/58 backstory shuffle; ANN's ep 16 review independently confirms the karaage/father-son arc swap. Two refinements to stored zone facts: ep 60 also covers ch 210 and the first part of 211 before jumping to 215-216 (ep 61 resumes 211, not 211-214 from scratch), and the ep 46/49 zone note should say the skipped material is the Azami-Joichiro reveal (end of 149 + 150-151), not the survivor-hunt matches themselves (152-155 aired in ep 46). Continue points follow the honest-position rule: first chapter the viewer has not yet seen (46->150, 56->195, 16->35, 22->54, 60->211).

annotation_updates.note: Refined: ep 60 covers 210 + first part of 211, then jumps to 215-216; ep 61 resumes 211 (not from scratch), covers 211-214, closes 217. Stored zone said ep 60 = 215-216 only and omitted 210/211-part.

Corrected wording: what ep 46 skips is the Azami-Joichiro reveal/takeover material (end of ch 149 + chs 150-151), NOT the survivor-hunt matches - the survivor hunt (152-155) airs in ep 46 itself; the skipped reveal is backfilled in ep 49 (MAL ep-46 thread: 'skipped the Big Reveal and went straight for the Survivor's Hunt').

flags_for_sean: Continue-point semantics used for skip-then-backfill zones: continue = first chapter the viewer has NOT yet seen (ep 46 -> 150, ep 56 -> 195, ep 16 -> 35, ep 22 -> 54, ep 60 -> 211), so a switcher re-covers a few already-watched chapters rather than missing the skipped ones. If the render instead wants 'first chapter beyond everything consumed', these five entries would need remapping (46->156, 56->202, 16->45, 22->58, 60->217).

Eps 20-23 fragment lists (49-50/54/56 in ep 20; 55/57 in ep 21; 48 in ep 22; 53/55 in ep 23) are page-level presentation glimpses documented only by the fandom wiki's two-sided map; the mainline ends (48, 52, 57, 58) are corroborated (MAL page-exact for 20/22, brackets for 21/23). Eps 21 and 23 marked medium accordingly.

Wiki chapter-title numbering quirk noted in passing: the wiki has duplicate pages 'Chapter 210: Absolutely Fair Judges' (stale) and 'Chapter 210: The Rotten Bonds of East and West' / 'Chapter 211: Absolutely Fair Judges' (live, used by the maps) - the live pages agree with Wikipedia's volume 25 chapter list, so no repair needed.
